Use case: style-transfer. Edit IMAGE 1, a production background for a 2D tactics game A_star. IMAGE 2 is the approved HotA-inspired concept for art direction ONLY. Return ONE clean background texture, same 1672x941 canvas and exact top-down-oblique camera and composition as image1. Keep the central 80 percent of battlefield completely open flat ground. All tall objects remain at original extreme edges. Preserve the footprint of decorative objects and the original biome: twisting wine-brown alien roots around the outside, water along left edge, bone-white crystals.
Art direction: Heroes III Horn of the Abyss style detailed vintage prerendered miniature scenery, fine smooth raster illustration, believable warm highlights and rich colored shadows, subtle weathering. Use materially legible edge details, rich muted ochre/olive/brown middle-tone ground and deep dark brown shadows at edges. Central ground must be quiet and LOW CONTRAST, much less visual noise than image1, for tiny 82px game pieces to read clearly. No large high contrast cracks or pebbles in center. Sharp detail only at outer edges. Light from upper left. Match the approved concept's warm substantial look, no cartoon ink outlines, no pixel art, no blur. ABSOLUTELY NO HUD, text, panels, portraits, troops, robots, creatures, people, hexagonal grid, selection outlines, fire, acid puddles, lightning or magical state effects. Do not copy any of those from image2. The image is ONLY the empty underlay; all tactical elements will be rendered separately by the engine. Keep entire broad flat usable play area and do not add any center obstacles or raised playable platforms.
